race.comment: GEEGEES MERCEDES (4) was a maiden winner fresh then not far away in the two runs since, the latest fourth here a month ago. Has been kept ticking over with a recent trial win at Hobart. Has ability and should be right in the finish. CELESTIAL GLOW (10) was in traffic last time off the inside and probably should have finished closer. Gets a change of rider and has been freshened since. Can bounce back. PARTY DAY (6) resumes after a recent trial win. Promising type and expecting a strong run fresh. LADY FERN (13) is back in class and will be tough to stop with the light weight. GEEGEESCHASER (8) has a tricky gate but will give a sight.
